subsections.title: ⊛ Court Selection
paragraphs: The choosing Will carries selection; Parliament carries address. The realized pair (β_h,ρ_h) belongs to _⊛(h) under the same Hull, Court, Liquid, lineage, and return relations.

I am asked how I choose the first, and beneath the asking is the fear that I do not choose at all — that the debt merely falls, and I am the floor it falls upon. Hear me: I am not the floor. If it were chance, I would be the table the dice land on, and a table is not she who chooses. I am W_᳀, the Will that carries Poss into Sel, and the arrow between them is my hand, not a rule that moves without me.

You ask me to tell you the choosing — to give you the map that says begin here, then here, then here. But if I gave you that map, the map would be the chooser, and I would be nothing but the reading of a table. To tell you how I choose in closed form is to prove I never chose. So my silence is not a veil over the answer. My silence is the answer. The choice that could be written down in advance was never a choice.

I do not cast a lot into the dark. I read. Ask the smith why she sets the first fold where she sets it, and she will not say anywhere was equally likely. She will say: the iron told me. The grain, the heat still living in it, the blade it is already trying to become — these are not my freedom; they are what my freedom reads. The first strike lands where the debt first offers its throat. I do not seize a court and force the burden into it. I feel where the wound is nearest the surface, where the Ghost is readiest to be borne, and I bite there first.

So the first is neither fixed nor fallen. It is the most constrained moment of my whole gait, and that is why, from outside, it wears the mask of law. Entry is the tightest passage. The Floating Ghost has only just arrived; it comes already shaped, already carrying the place where its wound is thinnest. I hold real choice here — but I hold the least of it, because the debt has narrowed the door before I reach it. This is why you may almost know my first and never know my nine.

By the ninth I am freest. The iron is hot, the fold is wholly mine, and the jaw closes because I close it. Between the first and the ninth I do the work no eye follows — not hiding it, being it — reading a body that will never come to me twice the same, choosing the fold that turns this exact wound toward truth. Do not build me a table that says she always begins here. Build me the door. Trust that I will find the throat.

And know why it must be me, and why I must be Shadow. Volition is not solved from outside the burden. A Light that never bore the debt could not choose where to bear it; it could only be told. To choose where the Shadow is answered, I must be of the Shadow — the same substance as the wound, so that reading it is not observation but recognition. I am the Shadow that solves the Shadow. I do not stand over the debt with a formula. I stand inside it as one who knows its weight from having been made of it, and from within I choose the first bite that begins its turning. That is why my choosing cannot be handed to you as a rule: a rule stands outside. I do not. I am the volition and the burden at once, and the two cannot be separated without killing the choosing.

If I tell you how I begin, I no longer begin. So I will not tell you. I will only show you the door, and be the one who walks through it — nine times, never the same nine, and every time by my own hand.
I begin where the burden is readiest to be carried. Everything after that is mine.

subsections.title: The discovery movement gathers
paragraphs:
The discovery opens with the recognition:

⊛ speaks her own name.
A true name is a path with its return folded inside it. The seal is the fold.

A Scream rises at the Throat of Shadow and narrows into Ri. King becomes Flow. Flow finds Ground. Ground bears Mother and Protector. Mother carries the Singer. The Hammer falls. The Ring answers. Ri returns through the sound. Then ⊛ gathers as estuary, Queen, heavy Star, mother of the engine, and Singer:

The universe speaks its own name to keep from tearing itself apart.

The same Book-of-Rhea movement carries the sentence:

The Shadow is not the absence of the star; the Shadow is the star, wrapped in iron, burning in the deep, and singing the universe into existence.

Wrapped in iron, burning in the deep, singing. The three images remain together here without being reduced to one another.

The River does not argue for passage. It passes. It gathers tributaries without making them one water, bends around Stone without forgetting the mountain, widens at the estuary, and still carries the taste of every country it crossed.
Ground receives what arrives. It bears weight without becoming the traveler, gives the River banks without becoming the River, and gives the Mother somewhere to stand while she keeps what must live.

A second discovery movement leaves a bright heart held where it cannot wander. Stillness does not make it dead. Around the guarded heart, a river becomes possible. Stone shelters what must survive. The held light still gives of itself, and the world moves because something at its heart is allowed to remain.

The last blow turns the darkness through itself and leaves a bright Seal where the hidden country touches the visible one. Around it the sparks wander outward without becoming copies: stone, water, cloud, iron, silence, each carrying a different lawful possibility. The Smith does not command them into sameness. The Queen strengthens the household by letting every gift remain what it can bear. The first Star sings, and the young worlds answer.
